decisions.reason: As a design-led decorative line close to the core range, it was cheap to test, but after several years and with multiple similar options in the portfolio, management would likely reallocate space and attention unless its value had clearly materialized.

This transparent burnout decorative fabric is a relatively fashion-sensitive extension with overlap to other decorative launches, so once uncertainty has had time to resolve its option value is less likely to justify keeping it.

Because it is another closely related burnout decorative fabric introduced alongside several nearby alternatives, the firm is likely to prune it if sales traction has not become clearly strong by 2022.

A velour-like upholstery fabric fits the established assortment well, can use existing warehousing and service capabilities, and likely has enough continuing option value to retain unless results are clearly weak.

The flame-retardant inbetween fabric adds a functional, specification-based offer with good fit to the firm's dependable supply model, so keeping it is relatively inexpensive and potentially valuable.

This lining fabric is a close-in, service-supporting extension that can be carried with limited additional commitment, so management would slightly favor keeping it unless better uses for the resources become pressing.
